task.title: Filter corpus samples by attempt outcome
task.objective: Select records containing an exact success, failure, or blocked attempt while preserving complete validation, deterministic ordering, and filter composition
acceptance_criteria: The attempt-outcome option accepts exactly success, failure, or blocked
A record matches when at least one attempt has the requested outcome
Records without attempts do not match
Trust, example, and attempt-outcome filters compose conjunctively
Limits apply after filtering and invalid records suppress all stdout
